summary: Comprehensive backend (25 pytest tests, 100% pass) and frontend E2E (Playwright) testing of the restructured FinNota app. All critical flows pass: auth (login + httpOnly cookie + wrong password + /me), master data (seed verification for sumber-dana [K/TF/KOP/PENG] & kode rekening [1.1..2.11] & jenis dialokasikan on 2.11), jenis auto-derivation (kode starting with '1' -> pendapatan; others -> belanja; manual 'dialokasikan' allowed), item-barang with kode_rek + kategori + enriched kode_rek_nama, CSV import with normalized headers 'NAMA BARANG/KODE REK/SUMBER REK' mapping to nama/kode_rek/kategori, nota create with multiple items that each carry their own kode_rekening + kategori (per-item), per-item jenis auto-derivation (2.2->belanja, 1.1->pendapatan), auto item total & total_nota, reports/pendapatan-pengeluaran grouped sections with total_transaksi = pendapatan - belanja, reports/rincian-belanja grouped by sumber_dana with kode_rekening filter, reports/arus-kas with manual input upsert and kas_belum_disetor = jumlah_penambahan - jumlah_pengeluaran, user mgmt + 403 for non-admin on /api/users. Frontend: login, master data all 4 tabs (incl. Sumber Dana with seeded entries), Input Nota (per-item kode & kategori selects, auto-total Rp 150.000 for 10x5000 + 1x100000, Jenis badge Belanja/Pendapatan correctly shown per item), Daftar Nota list + detail modal showing kode_rek/kategori per item, Laporan 3 tabs (PP with sections & stats, Rincian/Sumber Dana grouped, Arus Kas with input form -> Kas Belum Disetor Rp 450.000 computed correctly).

minor.issue: No uniqueness constraint on kode (duplicates allowed) — carries over from iter 1.
Return 200 even when resource does not exist (no 404). Carried over.

Report is called 'Rincian Belanja' but includes items of all jenis (pendapatan/belanja/dialokasikan). If intent is belanja-only, add jenis filter; else rename. (Observed: UI tab 'Rincian Belanja / Sumber Dana' showing 1.1 PENJUALAN rows too.)
Payload accepts arbitrary periode/sumber_dana; no cross-check against master sumber_dana. Minor.

action_items: (Optional) Decide whether 'Rincian Belanja / Sumber Dana' should filter to jenis=belanja only — currently shows pendapatan items too; rename or filter.
(Optional) Add 404 to PUT /users/{id} and DELETE /nota/{id} when not found.
(Optional) Enforce unique index on master kode (kode-rekening, sumber-dana) to avoid duplicates.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: jenis_from_kode defaults non-'1' codes to 'belanja' — fine, but it means codes like 'TEST-E1' are classified as belanja silently; acceptable.
server.py: _nota_filter adds $gte/$lte range dict only if start or end set — OK.
server.py: /api/reports/arus-kas sums ALL penambahan including kas_bulan_lalu_belum_disetor + sponsor_sisa — matches spec. Setoran counted as pengeluaran — matches spec.
server.py: Mongo ObjectId correctly excluded via _serialize helper.
CORS: allow_origins set from FRONTEND_URL + localhost with allow_credentials=True — httpOnly cross-site cookies work (SameSite=none; Secure).
Auth: no brute-force lockout (not required by spec but a hardening item).
Master item-barang import normalizes headers 'NAMA BARANG','KODE REK','SUMBER REK' to lowercase+underscore and maps 'sumber_rek' to 'kategori' — works as intended.
seed_data_creation: Test suite creates TEST_* prefixed master items (kode-rekening, sumber-dana, item-barang) and TESTN-001 nota + a transient test user; TestZCleanup removes them. Playwright UI test cleaned up UI-TEST-N1 + TESTN-001 notas afterwards.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py is updated for the restructured API: nota is header + per-item kode_rekening/kategori/jenis, sumber_dana stored as kode (K/TF/KOP/PENG), reports endpoints are /reports/pendapatan-pengeluaran, /reports/rincian-belanja, /reports/arus-kas, and /arus-kas-input (GET/POST upsert). Pytest runs with xdist (2 workers, loadscope). The old /reports/item-per-sumber-dana no longer exists. 25 tests, all passing.
